mechanism_narrative: A sustained upward trend in the federal funds rate over the past month signals monetary tightening, compressing discount rates applied to equity cash flows, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are not significantly negative (t-test p > 0.05) during periods of sustained FEDFUNDS increases.

mechanism_narrative: A sudden rise in the unemployment rate above 4% percentage points triggers a negative S&P 500 forward return signal over the next 5 trading days, reflecting market anticipation of economic weakness.
failure_condition: 5-day returns are not significantly negative (t-test p > 0.05) during UNRATE spikes above 4pp.

mechanism_narrative: Concurrent rises in the federal funds rate and CPI inflation index signal coordinated monetary tightening, amplifying discount rate pressure on equities and generating negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
candidate_trigger: Both FEDFUNDS and CPIAUCSL rise simultaneously over the past month
failure_condition: 20-day returns are not significantly negative (t-test p > 0.05) during periods of dual monetary tightening.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained upward trend in industrial production over the past quarter indicates expanding economic activity, boosting corporate earnings expectations and driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: 60-day returns are not significantly positive (t-test p > 0.05) during periods of sustained INDPRO upward trends.

mechanism_narrative: A sudden decline in housing starts below 1,200 units triggers a negative S&P 500 forward return signal over the next 20 trading days, reflecting market concerns about housing market weakness and broader economic slowdown.
failure_condition: 20-day returns are not significantly negative (t-test p > 0.05) during HOUST drops below 1200.

mechanism_narrative: GDP growth outpacing housing starts contraction signals imbalanced demand, leading to market uncertainty and negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
candidate_trigger: GDPC1 rises >5% from prior quarter and HOUST falls >10% from prior month
failure_condition: 20-day returns are not significantly negative (t-test p > 0.05) during periods of concurrent GDP growth and housing contraction.

mechanism_narrative: In a late-cycle expansion regime, a drop in the unemployment rate below 3.5% triggers positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days as markets anticipate sustained labor market strength.
failure_condition: 20-day returns are not significantly positive (t-test p > 0.05) during UNRATE drops below 3.5% in late-cycle expansion periods.

mechanism_narrative: CPI inflation exceeding 2.5% triggers market concern about overheating, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day returns are not significantly negative (t-test p > 0.05) during CPIAUCSL spikes above 2.5%.
